candidates.rationale: This atomic increment of send_io credits in the error path (err_alloc) could lead to credit accounting issues if not properly synchronized with other credit operations. Incorrect credit management in SMB direct can cause resource exhaustion or denial of service.

Waking up the wait queue after modifying credits could trigger race conditions if consumers are processing credits concurrently. Improper wake-up timing in credit-based flow control can lead to synchronization issues.
